stoxx.short_exact_excerpt: Monday through Friday between 0:00 and 22:15 CET
stoxx.paraphrase: The default STOXX Europe calendar excludes New Year, Good Friday, Easter Monday, Christmas and Boxing Day. The Target and Eurex variants also exclude May1; Eurex excludes December24. May9 and May20 are not excluded in any of those calendars. Index-specific exceptions require explicit methodology. Dissemination ends after the last trading system in the regional universe closes.
stoxx.conclusion: These are expected index calculation dates under the administrator regional/default and relevant European variants, independently of XETR venue assignment. Yahoo retained identity metadata calls both ^STOXX and ^STOXX50E Zurich. Missing observations stay missing; the precise provider omission cause is not established.
stoxx.timing_gate: Use the source maximum22:15CET at fixedUTC+01 as a conservative upper-bound21:15UTC on each prior observation date. This is later than22:15CEST in June and still before nextUTCmidnight. It establishes eligibility, not the exact index close or Yahoo print time.
stoxx.xetr_role: Matching session-date proxy for the observed April–June cash dates; not claimed as the physical index venue or exact index close source. For May9/20 the index-calendar expectation is independently source-supported.
